name: After Hours #29 — Unfinished Sketch
description: A city half-drawn, ink still open. Polaroids of streets that already forgot their names. After Hours is a 50-piece open edition. Token 29 is unlimited: anyone can mint this still. After Hours is a 50-piece open edition of lo-fi rooms. Each piece is its own unlimited ERC-1155: rain on glass, desk lamps, last trains, and the kind of quiet you can mint forever.
